'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**[[Inflation]] in the [[United Kingdom]] increases to 10.1%, the highest level since February 1982, due to [[UK cost of living crisis|increasing fuel and food prices]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2022/aug/17/uk-inflation-cost-of-living-crisis-recession-looms (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Matanzas oil storage facility explosion]]
**The death toll from the August 6 fire at a supertanker port in [[Matanzas]], [[Cuba]], rises to 16. All the deceased were firefighters who were battling the blaze. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-62593749 (BBC News)]
*Twenty-six people are killed by [[wildfire]]s in [[Algeria]], mostly in the city of [[El Taref]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-62581108 (BBC News)]. 

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–Turkey relations]]
**[[Israel]] and [[Turkey]] restore full diplomatic relations for the first time since 2018. [https://www.axios.com/2022/08/17/turkey-israel-normalize-ties-ambassadors (''Axios'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*Police in [[Tokyo]], [[Japan]], arrest a former member of the [[2020 Summer Olympics]] organising committee after prosecutors accused him of [[graft (politics)|graft]] and [[bribery]]. [https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/sports/tokyo-prosecutors-arrest-former-member-olympic-panel-paper-2022-08-17/ (Reuters)]
*The [[High Court of Australia]] rules that [[Google]] is not liable for [[defamatory]] material within [[hyperlink]]s that it serves as part of its search results. [https://www.axios.com/2022/08/17/australian-court-rules-google-not-publisher-defamation-case (''Axios'')]
